aliases: Poe Companies/PowerHouse Carroll County data center
status_detail: Kentucky-based development team announced a planned $9.6B data center campus on about 550 acres along Green's Bottom Road east of I-71; team has secured purchase options, completed early due diligence/site and power studies, and begun stakeholder engagement.
notes: Developer project page says about 300 acres of the 550-acre site would be active campus area, with closed-loop cooling and planning/permitting/community engagement underway; WHAS reported LG&E/KU described the load as 800 MW.

status_detail: DECA project page says the Carroll County/Ghent data center is announced and moving through permitting; Carroll County Fiscal Court authorized a limited KEDFA support letter for DECA to begin state incentive application, explicitly not a county siting/zoning approval.
notes: Project materials describe a major infrastructure investment in Ghent with closed-loop cooling, confirmed transmission, public engagement/permitting in progress, and preliminary estimates of about $40M annual local tax impact. Third-party/community summaries place the site on Sharon Road east of Ghent and estimate about $4B investment, but figures are developer-provided.
